name: compile_fractals
description: Compiles indented SASS into CSS to verify output. The system exposes no authoring mixins — compose in markup and use this only for the rare custom declaration.

sassCode.description: Indented SASS code (plain declarations; the styles directory is on the load path).

className.description: Optional CSS class name to wrap the declarations under (e.g. 'preview-card'). Defaults to 'element'.
